news.casting_brief: Supply-chain analysts, battery manufacturers, mining operators, policy coordinators, and industrial buyers caught between local shocks and global stakes.
news.script_brief: A single cobalt disruption ripples outward, exposing how interconnected battery supply chains amplify a local shock into worldwide chaos. Tension: researchers race to map bottlenecks while industries scramble. Beats: the first tremor, the cascade, the warning, the call for system-wide coordination.
news.news_close_brief: Researchers warn that protecting battery supply chains demands system-wide coordination, as critical bottlenecks can turn a single local cobalt shock into a global crisis.

dramatic_state.dramatic_question: Will the Announcer expose the cobalt bottleneck in time to coordinate the world, or will Terwilliger's hoarding let one local shock cascade into global battery chaos?
dramatic_state.character_a_wants: To broadcast the cobalt bottleneck map and force system-wide coordination
dramatic_state.character_b_wants: To hoard the disrupted cobalt and corner the EV battery supply chain
dramatic_state.ending_change: The bottleneck map goes public, breaking Terwilliger's corner; rivals begin coordinating cobalt supply instead of letting the cascade spread.

rendered_lines: In tonight's tale, a single cobalt disruption ripples outward through the world's battery supply chains, turning local shock into spreading chaos.
Kimberley caved an hour ago. The batteries will start snapping their chain before we can cut them loose.
London dark by dawn, then the ports and the factories, if this chalk holds while I mark the board.
Mark the ports after dawn and the Lagos wire dries up before we can initial it.
My word keeps that line open, no matter which way the chalk runs.
Musical interlude bridging setup into the next phase.
Run the next load through the border boys and keep that chalk steady on the southern edge so it doesn't run before the board sees it.
Those boys still settle accounts with the same crowd that pulled the Lagos wire, and chalk won't stop the French from tracing it back here by morning.
The dates already match on the marks you've got down -- better not add another before the inspectors pull the ledger.
Drake already initialed the extra column on the manifest, so the southern run clears before the board lifts the cover.
Her Marseilles names are already stamped on the duplicate copy that arrived yesterday.
Then the whole ledger comes out now and goes into the furnace with the rest.
Musical interlude bridging complication into the next phase.
The way those pages catch quick once they hit the grate leaves the Port Said dockhands with nothing left to claim once the tide turns.
The duplicate manifests we routed through Tunis won't light a single bulb on the other side after the inspectors clear the dock.
The boy from the night shift left his gloves on the rail again.
Those Tunis manifests will only blacken the same grate the others already cooled.
Researchers caution that critical bottlenecks demand system-wide coordination to keep battery supply chains from turning any local cobalt shock into lasting global crisis.
